title: JAILJUDGE: A Comprehensive Jailbreak Judge Benchmark with Multi-Agent Enhanced Explanation Evaluation Framework

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing the performance (such as F1 scores) of jailbreak judge models on a dataset of multilingual harmful prompts across ten different languages. The languages are categorized into high-resource, medium-resource, and low-resource to investigate if the judges exhibit performance disparities or bias against low-resource languages.
